Hi Sanjay —

Great to hear — excited to run this with you. Recap and next steps from our side:

Recap from today's call:
- Objective: improve clinical note summarization (reduce average tokens per summary while keeping clinical fidelity).
- Success criteria (provisional):
  - Quantitative: ROUGE/LU similarity target >= 0.78 vs. internal gold set; average summary length reduction >= 20% without loss of key-entity recall.
  - Latency/cost: 95th pct latency <= 350ms for 512-token context at target throughput; token cost per summary <= $0.XX (we'll finalize number once we see logs).
  - Qualitative: clinical SME accept rate >= 85% on sampled outputs.

POC plan & ownership:
- You (Acme): provide seed prompt set (~300), anonymized production logs (~2k) and a short list of priority cases.
- Redwood (Marissa/Aditya/Monica): build eval harness, run baseline vs. 2 model variants, provide prompt tuning suggestions, and a short report with recommendations.

Deliverables & timeline (proposed):
- Nov 24: Acme delivers seed prompts + sample logs to shared Drive.
- Nov 25-27: Redwood prepares eval harness + baseline runs.
- Dec 1: Mid-point sync to review preliminary results and adjust success criteria.
- Dec 10: Final results, write-up, and next-step recommendation.

Attachments: redwood-poc-eval-plan-template.xlsx (template with scoring rubric).

Action items for Acme:
1) Drop seed prompts + sample logs into the shared folder (see Drive link below). Please include a README mapping prompt ids to use cases.
2) Confirm which internal owner will accept the final SME review (name + email).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AexamplePocEval
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (deal: ACME-2187)

I'll loop in Aditya and Monica for technical and onboarding details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-poc-eval-plan-template.xlsx (xlsx, 32KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-21T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC next steps and sample prompts

Hi Sanjay —

Couple of technical notes on the data format and what we need for an accurate baseline:

Required for logs:
- Plaintext newline-separated files (.txt or .jsonl) with fields: prompt_id, input_text, reference_summary (if available), timestamp, context_metadata (redact PII).
- If delivering JSONL, one record per line; max file size per upload = 500MB (we can accept multiple parts).

Prompt set guidelines:
- Please include the original clinician instruction and any system-level context used (e.g., "Summarize the following note focusing on discharge instructions").
- Mark prompts that are high-priority for evaluation with a tag: PRIORITY=1

Evaluation harness notes:
- We'll run two model variants: open-quantized-v1 and open-quantized-v2 (different temperature / decoding settings).
- Baseline metrics: ROUGE-L, entity recall (custom NER comparison), and a simple human accept/reject rate for a 200-sample blind review.

If you prefer, Monica can send a short script to validate your JSONL before upload.

Thanks,
Aditya
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

--

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Prompt collection instructions + validation script

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks — attaching a short prompt-collection guide and a validation script to make uploads painless. Quick checklist for your engineers:

1) Files: provide two folders in the Drive share — /seed_prompts (CSV or JSONL, ~300 items) and /prod_logs (JSONL, ~2k entries).
2) Required fields for JSONL: prompt_id, input_text, reference_summary (null if not available), priority_tag, submission_time.
3) Redaction: remove direct patient identifiers. We accept hashed IDs for mapping.
4) README: include mapping of prompt_id -> case type and expected output length.

Scoring rubric (attached in the xlsx):
- ROUGE-L target >= 0.78
- Entity recall (critical entities): >= 92%
- SME accept rate >= 85% on a 200-sample blind set

Attachments included here: prompt-collection-instructions.pdf (pdf, 12KB), validation_script.sh (shell script, 4KB).

I'll schedule a short onboarding call w/ your engineering team for Monday Nov 24 at 10:00 AM PST to review the upload process. Please confirm attendees.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: prompt-collection-instructions.pdf (pdf, 12KB); validation_script.sh (sh, 4KB)
